title: Allpass Filter
text: 单节或多节全通滤波器，输入 2 路、输出 1 路；按 {Internal allpass structure} 指定滤波器结构 Minimum；{Specify coefficients from input port} 用于指定全通多项式系数的标志、{Allpass polynomial coefficients} 指定最小乘法器形式的系数、{Wave Digital Filter allpass coefficients} 指定波数字滤波器形式的系数、{Indicate if last section is first order} 指定最后一节是否为一阶、{Lattice allpass coefficients} 指定格型形式的系数、{View Filter Response} 指定可视化滤波器响应、{Simulate using} 指定要运行的仿真类型 Interpreted，按实例取值。

ports.name: x
ports.summary: 输入数据 column vector | row vector | matrix

ports.name: coeffs
ports.summary: 全通滤波器系数 column vector | row vector | matrix

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: 全通滤波器的输出 column vector | row vector | matrix

params.name: Internal allpass structure
params.values: 滤波器结构 Minimum multiplier (default) | Wave Digital Filter | Lattice

params.name: Specify coefficients from input port
params.values: 用于指定全通多项式系数的标志 off (default) | on

params.name: Allpass polynomial coefficients
params.values: 最小乘法器形式的系数 [ -2^(-1/2), 1/2 ] (default) | N -by-1 matrix | N -by-2 matrix | N -by-4 matrix

params.name: Wave Digital Filter allpass coefficients
params.values: 波数字滤波器形式的系数 [ 1/2, -2^(1/2)/3 ] (default) | N -by-1 matrix | N -by-2 matrix

params.name: Indicate if last section is first order
params.values: 最后一节是否为一阶 off (default) | on

params.name: Lattice allpass coefficients
params.values: 格型形式的系数 [-2^(1/2)/3, 1/2] (default) | N -by-1 column vector | 1-by- N row vector

params.name: View Filter Response
params.values: 可视化滤波器响应 button

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: 要运行的仿真类型 Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
